name: darkness aura
desc:
A 15-foot radius of magical darkness extends out from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, moves with it, and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts as long as the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} maintains concentration, up to 10 minutes (as if concentrating on a spell).
Darkvision can't penetrate this darkness, and no natural light can illuminate it. If any of the darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled.
